tasks.short: Develop, test and implement mining applications with bounded coding assistance.

steps.what: Design application requirements, data contracts and mining safety constraints
Develop computer application code from the defined requirements

loop.input: Defined requirements, interface schema and existing code
loop.output: Candidate code changes with requirement references
loop.check: Engineer reviews logic, units, failure handling and conformance to acceptance criteria
loop.stop: One correction cycle; unresolved logic or unsafe assumptions return to manual coding
loop.why_not_simpler: Native configuration is used first; remaining application logic varies with the operational need

steps.what: Test application calculations, interfaces and failure behaviour against independent expectations
outputs: tested application version and test findings

steps.what: Write application operating notes, limitations and implementation instructions
inputs: tested application version and test findings

steps.what: Check the release version and implement the application in the authorised mining environment
inputs: tested application version and test findings

tasks.design: Try existing application configuration in {OTHER}, the development and deployment toolchain, before bounded code drafting. Requirements, tests and implementation remain human steps, with a final-version gate on operational implementation and a native operating-note template in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Application logic and its documentation require repeated manual construction.
tasks.enabler_now: Code drafting can assist a defined change while independent engineering tests remain decisive.
tasks.still_hard: Correct mining assumptions, safety consequences and dependable failure behaviour.
tasks.human_edge: An engineer understands when executable software is operationally wrong.
tasks.altitude: Reduce mechanical coding effort while keeping engineering verification intact.

reach.learn: Translate engineering acceptance criteria into independent tests

evidence.claim: A controlled coding study found faster task completion, but this does not establish mining application savings.
A study of experienced developers found slower work with AI, supporting a conservative task-specific trial.
The proposed mining application labour estimate is an unmeasured scenario.

assumptions: Includes requirements, code, tests, operating record and real implementation; no savings are claimed on an ordinary code save.

Mining engineer produces field schema, units, interface expectations, operating limits and acceptance cases in s1, with capture fully counted. Absent data contracts require manual specification before drafting.
OTHER means existing development and deployment tools; native configuration first and no automatic production code execution.
s5 is operational implementation rather than same-system document saving; its final artifact and environment require a release check.
unknowns: Application complexity and independent test coverage
research_questions: Does bounded coding reduce total coding and correction effort on representative changes?

incremental.description: Maintain coding constraints and inspect assistance quality

approvals.approved_version: Exact tested application build, configuration, target environment and implementation instructions; changed code or configuration requires renewed testing and release checking.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=84, gross=16, upkeep=5, central net=11 E1. Low: uncommon mining interfaces and weak output metadata force substantial code reconstruction, retaining 95 hours plus upkeep for zero net. High: well-specified interfaces and a compatible application framework permit some draft reuse while independent testing remains full, retaining 89 hours plus upkeep for 6 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Select or devise economical materials-handling methods using checked comparisons and engineering judgement.

steps.what: Assess ore, waste, routes and operational handling constraints
Retrieve materials-handling equipment specifications, operating costs and method references
Record comparable quantities, capacities, route assumptions and cost inputs
Calculate equipment throughput and operating-cost comparisons under the specified scenarios
Select or devise materials-handling methods and equipment after checking comparisons
Write the method and equipment recommendation with assumptions and limitations
Check and share the final handling recommendation with operations colleagues

tasks.design: Configure equipment reference views in {OPS_SYSTEM}, checked comparison formulas in {SPREADSHEET} and a recommendation template in {DOCS}. Deterministic calculations support a human selection or devised method; a separate {EMAIL} step sends the checked recommendation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated input assembly and comparison tables add handling around the engineering choice.
tasks.enabler_now: Reusable formulas and templates can process explicitly captured comparable inputs.
tasks.still_hard: Route feasibility, material behaviour, maintainability and uncertain operating conditions.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer judges whether a nominally economical method can work on site.
tasks.altitude: Spend less time preparing comparisons and more on feasible handling methods.

evidence.claim: Deterministic capacity and cost worksheets can reuse comparable inputs, without making the equipment selection; no measured mining benefit is available.

assumptions: Includes operational assessment, reference lookup, comparison capture, calculations, selection, writing and internal handoff.

Engineer produces capacity, quantity, route length, cycle assumptions, costs, units and formula choice in s3; capture and formula checking are counted in s3/s5. Noncomparable supplier figures require manual reconciliation.
Native reference views and existing calculation templates first; no autonomous equipment selection.
Ordinary recommendation saves remain retained; only the actual send has a final-version gate.
unknowns: Comparability of vendor capacity and cost data
research_questions: How often do existing comparison formulas fit the actual route and material behaviour?

incremental.description: Maintain comparison formulas and reference fields

approvals.approved_version: Exact recommendation, comparison assumptions, attachments and operations recipients; changed inputs or content require another send check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=82, gross=18, upkeep=3, central net=15 E1. Low: unusual routes and incompatible vendor capacities require bespoke comparisons, retaining 96 hours plus upkeep for 1 net. High: comparable equipment data supports calculations while site-specific method writing stays largely bespoke, retaining 88 hours plus upkeep for 9 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Evaluate mining data and document new product, equipment or process concepts.

steps.what: Retrieve relevant mining performance, test and equipment data
Record data provenance, units, operating conditions and comparison limitations
Evaluate data quality and identify technically meaningful development opportunities
Run existing engineering calculations and inspect results for candidate concepts
Develop and assess new mining products, equipment or process concepts
Write the development concept record, supporting evidence and further test needs

tasks.design: Configure evidence views in {DATA_PLATFORM} and structured concept records in {DOCS}. Data evaluation and novel concepts remain human, and existing calculations in {OTHER}, the engineering analysis application, retain their present effort.
tasks.previous_blocker: Data provenance and concept records are assembled repeatedly.
tasks.enabler_now: Native evidence tables and concept templates can reduce repeated preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Separating causal improvement from operating variation and designing viable innovations.
tasks.human_edge: Engineering imagination and physical understanding determine which concepts deserve testing.
tasks.altitude: Improve traceability around new mining concepts.

reach.learn: Connect proposed changes to comparable operating evidence

evidence.claim: Native evidence views and concept record templates can reduce repeated handling; this development-time scenario is unmeasured.

assumptions: Includes data preparation, scientific evaluation, concept development and its written record.

Engineer produces source version, unit, operating context and limitations in s2 and concept reasons in s5-s6, with capture counted. Noncomparable records remain manual or are excluded explicitly from a comparison.
Native views and templates first; OTHER means existing engineering calculation software, whose present computation and inspection earn no saving.
Ordinary concept record saves remain retained without a self-approval stage.
unknowns: Data comparability and availability of standard concept records
research_questions: How much concept documentation is structure and evidence referencing rather than original engineering reasoning?

already_counted.description: Capture and check development evidence metadata

incremental.description: Maintain evidence views and concept template

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=90.25, gross=9.75, upkeep=3, central net=6.75 E1. Low: different ore conditions and incomplete test metadata prevent evidence-table reuse, retaining 97 hours plus upkeep for zero net. High: comparable operating records permit source reuse but concept reasoning needs bespoke writing, retaining 93 hours plus upkeep for 4 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Collaborate on mining machinery design, maintain design records and share the checked package.

steps.what: Retrieve mining and mineral treatment requirements and current design versions
Collaborate with engineering specialists on machinery functions, interfaces and design constraints
Write interface decisions, requirements and unresolved design issues
Design mining machinery components and update engineering drawings
Verify design performance, interfaces, safety assumptions and physical feasibility
Check and send the final design package to engineering colleagues

tasks.design: Use native design-version views, decision templates in {DOCS} and reusable drawing elements in {OTHER}, the CAD application. Collaboration, design reasoning and verification remain human; a separate {EMAIL} step sends the checked design version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Version retrieval and repeated design record and drawing structure consume effort around original design.
tasks.enabler_now: Native CAD libraries and document templates can reduce repeated drafting details.
tasks.still_hard: Machine performance, coupled interfaces and safety in mining conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Engineering specialists reconcile competing physical constraints.
tasks.altitude: Reduce routine design handling while preserving interdisciplinary engineering.

reach.learn: Keep drawing versions aligned with interface decisions

evidence.claim: Relatics supports requirements and verification records, illustrating structured engineering traceability rather than automated machinery design.
Native CAD reuse and document templates may reduce clerical drafting portions; this benefit is unmeasured.

assumptions: Includes collaboration, the separate decision record, actual design, verification and design handoff.

Engineer produces interface ID, requirement, drawing version, decision and unresolved issue in s3; capture is counted. Missing geometry or incompatible component metadata require manual drawing work in s4.
OTHER means existing CAD software; use native reusable elements first, with no automatic design acceptance.
Ordinary author saves remain retained without self-gates; final sharing is the separately checked action.
research_questions: Which recurring drawing elements are reusable without altering original engineering choices?

incremental.description: Maintain document fields and reusable drawing elements

approvals.approved_version: Exact drawing and design record versions, qualifications and engineering recipients; changes require another check before sharing.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=93, gross=7, upkeep=2, central net=5 E1. Low: novel machinery interfaces and incompatible component geometry prevent most reuse, retaining 98 hours plus upkeep for zero net. High: compatible component metadata allows some drawing reuse while novel load paths and interfaces remain bespoke, retaining 95 hours plus upkeep for 3 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Keep mining engineering accountable while reducing repeated software, comparison and design-document work.
reach: Coordinate software acceptance criteria and machinery interfaces with specialists
role.ambitious_version: A mining engineer with more attention for safe, practical innovations and less repetitive preparation.

job.title: Mining and Geological Engineers, Including Mining Safety Engineers
